checks: The double U1 commutator has odd x parity, making division by x a bounded one-derivative loss.
The leading coefficients in the cofactor are x(2f+xf_x)=rho_x and x^2 f_y=rho_y.
The normalization rank-one term is split only on compact annuli; globally its leading singularity requires exact cancellation.
Radial output tails use complete C_ren and bounded multipliers.
Both axis subtraction terms are compact into Xhat_s; their combined zero-trace image is closed.
Conjugation compactness is for each fixed N, not uniformly in N.
scope: Compact coupling commutators and local principal symbol only.
